name: nf-super-guarantee
description: Classify Norfolk Island employer super guarantee earnings and the 2026–27 transition under Payday Super. Use for Norfolk super, mixed mainland work, employee residence, labour contractors, salary sacrifice, annual base and contribution timing questions. Explains the statutory Norfolk earnings subset, one-twelfth adjustment, 11% versus 12% examples, payment-day boundary, eligible fund receipt and separate charge analysis. Includes primary sources, fictional computations and refusal conditions. This source-cited reference covers selected employer SG rules, requires the universal and social contributions workflow bases, and holds missing eligibility, instruments, other programmes and operational outputs.
